title: AppShell's responsive header rules are not implemented
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists

evidence.verified: `npx vitest run --project browser src/components/AppShell.responsive.test.tsx`: 2 tests pass. At a 700px viewport the header inner computes `flex-direction: column` and `align-items: flex-start`, the nav list computes `flex-wrap: wrap`, and 12 nav items occupy more than one row with `scrollWidth` no greater than `clientWidth`. At 1440px both revert to `row` and `nowrap`. Removing the media query fails both tests, with `expected 'row' to be 'column'` and `expected 1 to be greater than 1`. `npm run ci` exits 0.

details:
`components/AppShell.md:131` opens a section headed `Responsive (max-width: 768px)` and promises the header inner switches to `flex-direction: column`, with nav links set to `flex-wrap: wrap`. The edge case at `:204` repeats it, saying many nav items wrap to the next line on mobile.

`src/styles/components/app-shell.css` contains no `@media` block and no `flex-wrap` declaration. The only component stylesheet in the repository with a width media query is `src/styles/components/event-lanes.css:155`.

A consumer planning a mobile header on that promise ships one whose nav overflows instead of stacking.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.

Closed by implementing the section rather than deleting it. The breakpoint is written `48rem`, which is 768px at the browser's default root size, because `lint:styles` disallows pixel units and because a rem breakpoint follows a reader who enlarges that size. `event-lanes.css` already used the rem form.

The visual gate cannot see this rule. It captures at one 1440px viewport, so the new browser test resizes the viewport itself and is the only thing holding the stylesheet to the document.
